title: Mochizuki Honami — My Past Selves〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line:
That was great!
Yeah, that was good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, we're practicing in SEKAI today, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. We don't have any shows lined up or songs in the works at the moment, so it will just be regular practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wonder what our next big thing will be. I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It'd be nice to do another big event like Jam Fest.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Definitely.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Next time I meet with Mr. Shindo, I'll have to ask if we have anything on the horizon.)

rows.Speaker: First-Year Student
rows.Line: Excuse me! Is it true that the band who did that song for FizzYum Cider are in your year?

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Student
rows.Line: Hehe, finally started listening to Leo/need, have you? I'll have you know, I've been their fan since the school festival last year.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Student
rows.Line: Wow... If I had just been born a year earlier, I could be in the same cohort as Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They're talking about us...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They are. Oh, but we really shouldn't eavesdrop...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't exactly plug our ears, can we?

rows.Speaker: First-Year Student
rows.Line: Oh! I've actually spoken with their leader before! Just a little bit!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Student
rows.Line: With Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: First-Year Student
rows.Line: Yes! When I was moving classrooms one time, I dropped my pencil case and she picked it up for me! She was really nice and easy to talk to.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Student
rows.Line: It was a little surprising, actually. I thought a band leader would be more like, “follow my lead!” or “do that again and you're outta here!”, you know?

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Student
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean. Heck, I thought Hinomori was the leader myself until just a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is it really that surprising that Honami's our leader? I mean, she pulled everyone together for the choir recital in first year and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You say “and stuff”, but that's about it for leader-like things Honami's done in school, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess so... Ah, but she always makes sure to look like the leader when we take publicity photos.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's right. I've been practicing to make sure I look the part.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Surprising, huh...
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, this should be enough for today. Be sure to review the parts we practiced together as a group and your individual points that need improving.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We're really getting the nuances we're after in our performance lately. It's been so much fun to play.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But sometimes I put too much force into it, and the sound gets muddied. I've got to improve on that!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Once I'm done with my homework for the night, I'll look back over what we practiced and put some more time in...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay everyone, Miku, Luka. See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? I stopped Untitled, so why am I...
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Honami. All done with practice for the day?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but... When I tried to go home from the classroom, I ended up here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! Did you see that light over there?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Over by the bench? I did.
I think it must be a fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It sort of felt like one, but also a bit off... Let's go have a closer look.
se_walk_women_005_4

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It must have been this, right? It seems pretty similar to a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It does. But the shape is a little strange...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's true. The fragment of a feeling I saw before was round, but this one looks almost like a broken shard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami. Would you try touching this fragment... Or rather, this shard's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The fact that you tried to go home but couldn't, and the way this shard is reacting...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Somehow, it all feels connected.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see what you mean, but... Are we sure it's safe? We have no idea what kind of feeling it came from.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll try it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel something from the shard, as though...it's pulling my consciousness into it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Like you said, MEIKO, it could all be connected...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. Then we'll all touch it together, on three.

rows.Speaker: Len, Honami & MEIKO
rows.Line: One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Where am I?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It looks like another school SEKAI, but different from ours.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: True... Oh, are these photos? All of them show you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right... There are pictures of me walking Shibao, and even pictures of me drawing in kindergarten.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh. It's interesting to see how much your younger self already looks like you now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! A little Honami just came out of the picture!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: That's not right. I've been here from the start.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, grown-up me.
Oh, should I say “nice to meet you” instead?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, I think hello works...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you...really me?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: That's right. I'm you from a long time ago, and I was born from your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, it feels so funny talking to myself like this. There's so much I want to talk about.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, but...
First, can you take me someplace away from here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Someplace away from here? Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: This is where the scary me is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The...scary me?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Oh, no! She's coming! We have to hide!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wh-What just happened?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami! Are you alright?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I was a little startled when it suddenly got so bright, but I think I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Um... Okay, the little Honami is fine. But what about the other Honami?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? She's gone. Did she hide like you told us to?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, MEIKO, Len? I'm right here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, we know that. We're just looking for our Honami right now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right, but, that's me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ho...

rows.Speaker: Len & MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami shrunk?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Honami
rows.Line: What's all this about? I'd appreciate it if you could be quiet in here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A-Another me?!
